name: blinding-lapse-opponent-influence-nine-hand-to-memory-banishes-three
notes: Blinding Lapse (rKKDhaLJ8w): the opponent has influence 9 (7 in hand + 2 in memory, all Dungeon Guide so the random banish replays identically): the hand goes to memory and three cards are banished from it. Pre-fix playing it did nothing. LiquidAmnesiaBanish's ghost-slot defect is random: with the splice removed this fixture failed 8 of 30 replays (a later pick landed on the card banished a moment earlier); with it, 0 of 30.

rulesClauses: Target opponent with influence nine or more puts all cards from their hand into their memory. Then that player banishes three cards at random from their memory.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Three defects. (1) The generated body for Blinding Lapse was registered ONLY in $activateCardAbilities, a table nothing dispatches (an action's effect lives in $cardActivatedAbilities): playing Blinding Lapse paid its cost and then resolved with no effect at all. (2) That body moved the opponent's hand with while(count(GetHand())>0) MZMove($player, "theirHand-0", "theirMemory"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so it would have re-moved the same removed slot forever (an infinite loop). A live $cardActivatedAbilities registration in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php now moves the hand with MZMoveTopOfZone(). (3) LiquidAmnesiaBanish() (Custom/CardDQHandlers.php, shared with Liquid Amnesia) re-searched the memory with ZoneSearch(), which does not skip removed slots, so a later 'random' pick could land on the card banished a moment earlier (a no-op) and fewer than the printed number of cards were banished. It now splices removed slots first.
